defiscan.summary: Compound V3 (Comet) is a lending protocol that operates isolated markets for individual base assets (USDC, USDT, WETH), each accepting a curated set of collateral tokens. Unlike Compound V2's shared-pool model, V3 isolates risk per market: suppliers lend a single base asset and borrowers post collateral against it. All three Ethereum markets are upgradeable EIP-1967 proxies controlled by a Compound governance Timelock with a 48-hour delay, with $986.97M in total capital at risk across all admin-controlled contracts. The protocol depends on Chainlink price feeds and a ConstantPriceFeed for USDT pricing.

details.name: CometProxyAdmin
details.description: Immutable — Immutable proxy admin contract owned by the Governance Timelock. Can upgrade, deploy-and-upgrade, and change the admin of the three market proxy contracts (cUSDCv3, cUSDTv3, cWETHv3) via upgrade, upgradeAndCall, deployAndUpgradeTo, deployUpgradeToAndCall, and changeProxyAdmin. Controls $986.97M in direct capital across the three market contracts.

details.name: Compound Governance Timelock (48h)
details.description: Immutable — Central admin of the protocol with a 48-hour execution delay. Controls 40 permissioned functions across 10 contracts, including all market parameter changes (interest rates, collateral factors, supply caps, reserve targets), asset listing via addAsset/updateAsset, price feed configuration, factory and extension delegate settings, governor transfer, and reserve withdrawals via withdrawReserves and…

details.name: Zero Address (Renounced)
details.description: Revoked — The zero address appears as pendingAdmin on the Timelock, indicating no pending admin transfer is in progress. This permission is effectively inactive.

details.name: CompoundGovernor
details.description: governance · Upgradeable — Upgradeable on-chain governance contract (EIP-1967 proxy) that serves as the admin of the Timelock. COMP token holders submit and vote on proposals, which are then queued and executed through the Timelock with a 48-hour delay. The governor contract itself is upgradeable via a separate ProxyAdmin also owned by the Timelock, meaning governance can upgrade its own governor implementation.
